name: Kourovka Notebook Problem 20.71(b): a graph with three card types and five vertex orbits (answered)
result: Affirmative: the Cayley graph of the Suzuki 2-group of order 64 on F_8 x F_8 with connection set {(a,0),(a,a^3)}, minus the identity, has 63 vertices, three isomorphism types of vertex-deleted subgraphs and five automorphism orbits. Construction: a Suzuki 2-group Cayley graph with orbits separated by common-neighbour invariants.
